contexts.text: Instead of spice there shall be corruption ()... Spice = interior truth; corruption = the privation thereof. ( = that instead of the perception and affection of truth from good, and of the life thence, there will be the perception and affection of falsity from evil, in which there is nothing of life. AC 10254:4.) (Spice = Divine truth as to its Perceptive; corruption = its privation. AC 10540:6.) (Corruption = the perishing of what is vital. AE 637:17.)
